summary: Castellum, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to the employment agreement of its President and CEO, Glen R. Ives. The amendment extends his term through December 31, 2027, grants 773,630 incentive stock options with a $0.73 exercise price, accelerates vesting of 500,000 prior options, and adjusts base salary and bonus provisions, including an accretive acquisition bonus. No merger, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or similar special situation event is present. This is a routine executive compensatory arrangement reported under Items 1.01 and 5.02.
